r0008.invariant_derived_from_authority: a switch that fails leaves the previous pointer and previous current publication intact and no partial current state; the switch can then be retried. Nothing beyond that was asserted (no lock, ordering or concurrency semantics).
r0008.method: the production EodPublicationRepository::promoteCandidateToCurrent runs unmodified on a correction fixture (prior publication 10 current, candidate sealed for the same date). A SQLite trigger created in the test aborts one write the promotion makes; the trigger is dropped afterwards. Data set 1 aborts the pointer write, after eod_publications.is_current has flipped (prior 0, candidate 1). Data set 2 aborts the final eod_runs mirror write, after the pointer already names the candidate. Assertions: the failure surfaces; prior publication still current; candidate still non-current; pointer still names the prior publication; every eod_publications, eod_current_publication_pointer and eod_runs row equals its pre-attempt state; the same promotion then retried succeeds (candidate current, supersedes 10, pointer on the candidate, prior non-current).
